title: Client holding upload (Finspot OMS, ISIN Holding)
purpose: Each client's sellable demat holdings per ISIN before the market opens, so Finspot allows delivery sells. One line per client and ISIN, product CNC. Quantity: the demat balance (margin-pledged shares included: the pledge is released for the sale), less shares pledged to lenders, plus unpaid purchases held in CUSPA. No collateral benefit is given here (IS Collateral 0, collateral and broker collateral quantities 0, DP holdings quantity 0, as SharePro's file does): the value of pledged collateral after haircut is already in the client's limit in the RMS limit file, so giving it again here would count it twice. The haircut (0 to 1, from the day's VaR/haircut data; 1 when the security has none) and the close price are given for Finspot's valuation. The DP account is the client's demat account (BO ID) as Ledgerline holds it; the POA flag is Y when the client has a DDPI or POA for securities.

columns.name: IS Collateral
columns.note: 0 no collateral, 1 collateral. Ledgerline writes 0: collateral is in the RMS limit

columns.name: Collateral Mode
columns.note: Ledgerline writes 1, as SharePro's file and Finspot's sample do

columns.name: Haircut
columns.note: 0 to 1 (0.17 = 17%); 1 when the security has no haircut in the day's data

columns.name: Broker collateral Qty
columns.note: Quantity that gives only collateral benefit (the client cannot sell it). Ledgerline writes 0

columns.name: DP Holdings Qty
columns.note: Quantity available for sale only. Ledgerline writes 0, as SharePro's file does (the sellable quantity is in Holdings Qty)

columns.name: Close Price
columns.note: Previous close (rupees); also used for collateral after a corporate action

columns.name: Beneficary Holdings
columns.note: Ledgerline writes 0.000, as SharePro's file does

columns.name: Unpledge Holdings
columns.note: Left empty, as SharePro's file does

columns.name: DP account number
columns.note: The client's demat account as Ledgerline holds it (16-digit CDSL BO ID, or the NSDL DP ID and client ID)

columns.name: POA flag
columns.note: Y when the client has a DDPI (or POA) for securities with the DP, else N

source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet ISIN Holding (17 columns, title line 'ISIN Holding'); SharePro's FINSPOT_DP_HOLDING_UPLOAD files
